copy.storyHeading: Bermula dengan satu keluarga, satu rumah
story: Teratak Ideal started in 2013 when Puan Rohani renovated her own family home and discovered how few contractors would simply finish what they promised, on the date they promised it.

Thirteen years and 310 homes later we still work mainly for families — people living in the house while we work in it. That shapes everything: we tidy daily, we schedule around Raya and school holidays, and we never charge for anything you did not agree to in writing.

process.title: Berbincang
process.text: A free first visit to your home. We measure, listen, and talk through what your family actually needs — in Bahasa or English, whichever is easier. You get an itemised quotation within three working days.

process.title: Reka Bentuk
process.text: 3D drawings so you can see the result before anything is hacked. Instalment payment plans are arranged here, and we agree the schedule around Raya, school holidays or whatever matters to you.

process.title: Bina & Serah
process.text: Our own crew works clean and tidies daily — you are still living there. Photo updates every week, and nothing extra is charged without your written agreement first.
